subject: english
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.**

The spectacular

P. Indian economy, was largely based on coal

Q. expansion of electrification of the

R. the last 20 years, and the considerable

S. Chinese economic growth of
solution:
The correct answer is: SRQP. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Here, the first part of the whole sentence is already given.
 
• After that 'S' should be the best fit to keep the sentence meaningful. The first word of the 'S' part is "Chinese". So, if we connect it with the first one, the sentence will be like "*The Spectacular Chinese economic growth of...*" No other options are matching except this one to convey a meaningful sentence.
 
• Then 'R' follows 'S' to keep the sentence meaningful. The sentence will be like "*...Chinese economic growth of the last 20 years, and the considerable...*"
 
• After that 'Q' follows 'R' and connecting the parts will be like "*...the last 20 years, and the considerable expansion of electrification of the...*"
 
• Lastly 'P' should be placed as it is the closing statement.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4, i.e. SRQP.

**Let us look at the whole sentence after rearranging it:** *The Spectacular **S**. Chinese economic growth of **R**. the last 20 years, and the considerable **Q**. expansion of electrification of the **P**. Indian economy, was largely based on coal*
